title: Conventional Trabeculotomy versus Gonioscopy-Assisted Transluminal Trabeculotomy: A Retrospective Cohort Study

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) license, MDPI)

indication: medically uncontrolled open-angle glaucoma (IOP 21 mmHg or more; POAG, exfoliative, steroid-induced and other) without prior glaucoma surgery
design: retrospective single-centre cohort, one eye per patient; CT eyes operated 2014-2016, GATT eyes 2016-2018; follow-up of at least 3 months required

groups.description: conventional ab externo trabeculotomy with metal probes under a scleral flap (at most 120 degrees of Schlemm's canal) combined with phacoemulsification (Table 2 row 5)
gonioscopy-assisted transluminal trabeculotomy (suture, up to 360 degrees) combined with phacoemulsification (Table 2 row 6)
conventional ab externo trabeculotomy without phacoemulsification (Table 2 row 8)
gonioscopy-assisted transluminal trabeculotomy without phacoemulsification (Table 2 row 9)

series.notes: mean (median) ± SD (n) cells, leading mean read; n = 13 at every included visit; 6/12/24-month cells excluded (fewer eyes after dropout that included additional glaucoma surgery)
mean (median) ± SD (n) cells, leading mean read; n = 30 at every included visit; 12/24-month cells excluded (fewer eyes after dropout that included additional glaucoma surgery)
mean (median) ± SD (n) cells, leading mean read; n = 14 at every included visit; 6/12/24-month cells excluded (fewer eyes after dropout that included additional glaucoma surgery)

mean (median) ± SD (n) cells, leading mean read; n = 23 at every included visit; 1/3/6/12/24-month cells excluded (fewer eyes after dropout that included additional glaucoma surgery, although every eye had at least 3 months of follow-up)

exclusions.what: Table 2 visits after the per-visit n first falls below the preoperative n: CT with phaco 6/12/24 months (R5C7-C9), GATT with phaco 12/24 months (R6C8-C9), CT without phaco 6/12/24 months (R8C7-C9), GATT without phaco 1/3/6/12/24 months (R9C5-C9)
exclusions.reason: the Discussion states that the eyes completing follow-up fell by about half because of additional glaucoma surgery, loss to follow-up and referral; means at visits with fewer eyes are therefore partly censored at additional glaucoma surgery (outcome-defined exclusion, protocol inclusion 4). Visits where every eye is still present are kept.
whole-group rows duplicate the with/without phacoemulsification subgroups, which are extracted instead

exclusions.what: median values in parentheses inside the Table 2 cells
exclusions.reason: medians are not admissible; only the leading mean is read
duplicates of the Table 2 baselines at group level

exclusions.what: Table 4 medication-free rates, Tables 5-6 logistic regression, Figures 1-2 Kaplan-Meier success
exclusions.reason: proportions, model estimates and Kaplan-Meier estimates are not admissible

notes: Per-visit eye counts are printed in each Table 2 cell; the included visits all have the full preoperative n.
Additional glaucoma surgery was required in seven CT eyes and seven GATT eyes (Results).
Conventional ab externo trabeculotomy is extracted as angle_mims ('other angle procedures', like ab externo canaloplasty); it is not a bleb-forming or penetrating filtering procedure.
Preoperative IOP on medication (medically uncontrolled glaucoma); medication counts per visit are in Table 3; not extracted.
Group roles: CT and GATT are two standard techniques, phacoemulsification is a procedure variant; all role control. CT and GATT were operated in consecutive periods (non-randomized).
